session_a_heals_acknowledged: Wave 3 SYNC-ADV3-04 write-then-dispatch ordering (audit row IFF dispatch attempted)
GOAL-CMS S-P0-A heartbeat cache write on successful broadcast (DispatchDomainEventsJob:128)
summary: Outbox -> DispatchDomainEventsJob -> broadcaster cascade is structurally sound. Idempotency-key SSOT lives in DomainEvent.idempotency_key (UNIQUE). 12 active Persist*ToOutbox listeners + 6 cache/availability/loyalty listeners. EventServiceProvider::shouldDiscoverEvents() returns false (EventServiceProvider:271) -> listen array is authoritative. Two-phase claim+dispatch pattern in DispatchDomainEventsJob is correct (lockForUpdate -> commit -> broadcast outside tx). CatalogChanged.fromMenuMutation is a clean adapter for 9 source event types. ComposerProfilePublished is paired-fired with ComposerProfileChanged in ComposerProfileService:168-169 but ONLY the Changed sibling has a listener mapping - the Published event is silently absorbed (dead event).

findings.title: ComposerProfilePublished dispatched but has no listener mapping

evidence.detail: ComposerProfilePublished class exists at app/Events/ComposerProfilePublished.php:10. NOT present as a key in $listen. EventServiceProvider::shouldDiscoverEvents() returns false -> no auto-discovery. Dispatched at app/Services/Composer/ComposerProfileService.php:168 followed by ComposerProfileChanged::dispatch on line 169 (which IS mapped to InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange + PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox).
evidence.impact: Event fires into the void. Removal safe because the Changed sibling carries the real signal.

findings.recommendation: Either map ComposerProfilePublished to a domain-explicit listener (analytics hook for first-publish?) or remove the dispatch + the Event class. Safe to delete - no production behavior depends on it.
findings.owner_question: Should publication-vs-update be observable separately (e.g. for first-publish analytics or a notify-on-launch hook)? If no, we can drop ComposerProfilePublished entirely.

findings.title: PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox bound to 11 events; some pass through CatalogChanged.fromMenuMutation, others directly

evidence.detail: Listener subscribes via 11 event keys. handle() at app/Listeners/PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox.php:23 calls CatalogChanged::fromMenuMutation($event) which returns null for already-CatalogChanged events (line 22) and adapter result for 9 others. For ItemAvailabilityChanged it shares the same parent event as PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox -> both listeners write rows for the same domain mutation (one CATALOG_CHANGED, one ITEM_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED). This is intentional fan-out per WAVE5-DATA-004 (kiosk needs CATALOG_CHANGED, KDS/POS need ITEM_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED) but increases DomainEvent row count 2x for every rupture toggle.
evidence.impact: Operational only - 2 rows + 2 broadcasts per rupture. UNIQUE index on idempotency_key prevents true dup but doubles broadcast cost.

findings.recommendation: KEEP-AS-IS for V1.0.1 - the fan-out is by design. V1.0.2 backlog: consolidate to single broadcaster envelope + client-side filtering by event_type. Document the intentional duplication near the listen-array comment block.

findings.title: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox uses sha1(EventType|aggregate_id) - no discriminator; PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox uses sha1 including correlation_id + change_type

evidence.detail: OrderCreated: idempotency_key = sha1(EventType::ORDER_CREATED|order.id) - relies on one-shot semantics. CatalogChanged: idempotency_key = sha1(EventType|entityType|entityId|branchId|changeType|correlationId). The OrderCreated approach absorbs any second listener fire silently (queue retry, replay) - documented at line 19-23. CatalogChanged includes correlationId so the same item flipping twice in different requests creates distinct rows. Asymmetry is correct for the domain (order create == one-shot; catalog can churn) but uncommented for new contributors.
evidence.impact: None operationally. Pattern divergence may confuse maintainers.

findings.recommendation: Document the listener-idempotency-key convention in a single place (e.g. inline comment on the DomainEvent.idempotency_key column or a `docs/sync-listener-keys.md`). Note that correlation_id inclusion is the discriminator for replayable events.

findings.title: OrderCreated listener order: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox first, then DecrementItemAvailabilityOnOrder, DecrementStockOnOrderCreated, SendFcmOnOrderCreated. Documented but enforced only by array order.

evidence.detail: F-002 round-3 comment block (lines 128-137) explains: 'Persist*ToOutbox MUST run BEFORE side-effect listeners (FCM, loyalty) because outbox is SSOT for KDS/Kiosk/POS sync. With QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync, exception thrown by ShouldQueue listeners would prevent downstream listeners from running.' Order enforced solely by declaration order in PHP array. No runtime guard.
evidence.impact: Refactor that re-orders the array (e.g. alphabetical sort) would silently regress KDS visibility on FCM failure. F-002 evidence: 87 order.created rows before, then ZERO once FCM started failing.

findings.recommendation: Add a phpstan/lint rule or a sentinel test (tests/Feature/Sync/OrderCreatedListenerOrderTest) that asserts PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox is at index 0. Same for OrderStatusChanged.

findings.title: PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox payload includes 'payment_pending_counter' computed via (int) $order->payment_status === PaymentStatus::PENDING_COUNTER

evidence.detail: Expression is `(int) $order->payment_status === \App\Enums\PaymentStatus::PENDING_COUNTER`. If PaymentStatus is an int-backed enum and $order->payment_status is already cast, the (int) cast may collapse to 1/0 unexpectedly. PaymentStatus::PENDING_COUNTER would need to be 1 for the expression to flip booleanly. Verify the enum case value at app/Enums/PaymentStatus.php.
evidence.impact: If enum value !=1, the boolean always false -> client never sees pending_counter signal. Likely currently correct but fragile.

findings.recommendation: Replace with `$order->payment_status?->value === PaymentStatus::PENDING_COUNTER->value` or `PaymentStatus::PENDING_COUNTER === $order->payment_status` (enum equality) to avoid the (int) trap.

consolidation_opportunities: Remove ComposerProfilePublished if no first-publish observability is needed (ARCH-1).
Consolidate the OutboxRescue / OutboxRetryFailed / OutboxWebhookRetryFailed trio into a single base class with three queries (DRY) - DEFER to V1.0.2 because the 3 commands are DIRTY in session-A.
CatalogChanged.fromMenuMutation has 9 type-checks (CatalogChanged:42-114) - a Match expression or registry pattern would shrink it. Not a defect; cosmetic.
